## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · `domain:devx#2` · head `73e71abc93d399dd3e4a3f05bbf8740a1198a43d` · 2026-11-02T16:28Z

Checked against GitHub and the PR head, not against the report (os-dev-report 6582166017 on #28579).

- **Shape:** a draft to `main` with `Part of #28579 (slice 2 of 3)`, no closing keyword, `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`. It has no assignees and no reviewers. `skip-changeset` is correct, because only `docs/qa/platform-checklist/**` changes.
- **Path surface:** six files under `docs/qa/platform-checklist/` (+807/−39). It is not governed, and it changes no product code, no e2e spec and no contract face. The seat reads it with CI and no second agent.
- **Card rules (Wanted 2):** there is one new item per promise:
  - `package-customize-restore-display` (N-17)
  - `package-flow-override` (N-11/N-18/N-22)
  - `package-extension-field-c` (N-23c)
  - `customization-pair-ensure-door` (N-13/N-14)
  - `packageless-overlay-ceremony-and-close` (N-16a/N-16b)
  - `package-customization-counts-and-marks` (N-24/N-26b)
  - `setup-metadata-redirects-to-studio` (N-28)

  N-20b extends `access-permission-set-lifecycle` instead of adding a twin item. The order allows that, and the item's history row says so.
- **Slice-1 carry-overs:**
  - The four `FOLLOW-UPS.md` §13c items now name the Studio URL.
  - `org-override-registry-gate` now has its open side on the declared override in the pair, so its transitional knownGap is gone.
  - The two items that wait on #29374 are untouched.
- **Gates:**
  - `check:platform-checklist` exits 0. All 38 new anchors resolve (1134/1144), and the 10 that do not resolve are the same 10 as on the base.
  - `dispatch-gates` runs 16 of 16 commands, all exit 0.
  - The unit pins the new items name pass: ui 14 files / 242 tests, plus objectql, service-automation, runtime, metadata-protocol and the cli integration test, with 0 skipped.
  - The seat lands once every check on this head is green.
- **Accepted deviations:**
  - `packaged-display-class-direct-edit` is retired with `supersededBy: package-customize-restore-display`, although the cover is not one to one. The order allowed a retire only on full cover, but the item's premise is gone. Its title asserts ADR-0126 Regime O ("packaged views and dashboards are yours to edit directly"), which ADR-0146 replaced with customizing in the pair, so rewriting it in place would invert every clause. Its locked-flow clause is still scored by `packaged-automation-studio-lock` and `package-flow-override`.
  - One leg is not carried over: whether the platform's own `system_overview` dashboard can be customized. The successor uses `showcase_ops_dashboard`. Slice 3's `checklist-test` run measures the platform-dashboard case and records it.
  - `platform-core.metadata-authoring-roundtrip` acceptance[4] is reworded from "accepts a package-less overlay" to the ADR-0146 behaviour. The verify step is unchanged.
- **Out of scope:**
  - The Studio landing description and read-only hint still teach "customize with an environment overlay". That is filed as #29489 (`domain:ui`).
  - From source: uninstalling the read-only showcase base answers 422 `WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED` before the pair check runs (`FOLLOW-UPS.md` §14b). Slice 3's live spec expects 422 there, or sets up a writable base.
  - The `os migrate` item needs a planted package-less row, as the item's knownGaps describe.
  - `access-permission-set-lifecycle` still has no `automated` block. That is left for slice 3's run to decide.
  - `Skills-docs: none — checklist text only`.
- **Landing:** non-governed. Once every check on this head is green, the seat marks the PR ready and enables auto-merge. The card stays open for slice 3.
